registered_semantics_decisions_before_th: the 4h state mapping is corrected for the record's own material caveat: states are computed on COMPLETED 4h bins and a base bar never carries its own bin's state (counter attached_state_before_availability == 0 on every grid); the naive left-edge/backward-as-of mapping is red-proved as detectable in the engine self-check

the transition matrix is a point-in-time expanding-window count (a transition enters its row only after its outcome bin completed; counter matrix_row_contained_future_outcome == 0); a row with fewer than 5 observations yields no signal
the entry event is a FRESH signal (the card's 'entry after the signal is formed'); a persistent signal never re-enters after a flatten

the engine starts from the audited D/G accounting rail but every fill is charged ONE TICK ADVERSE as the card registers; the D/G spelling copied as the starting point had the entry (plus the stop and the capital-exhaustion exit) as a one-tick CREDIT and was corrected before the first run, with the sign pinned on every leg in both directions by the self-check

the exit set = rail TP (breakeven-anchored on the running average cost) + resting invalidation (same anchor) + the record's own opposite-signal exit (taken only while the position is profitable against the running average cost, blocked and counted otherwise) + the slice-end flatten

the record's falsification battery is registered as four family-level readers (transition-matrix stability, exit asymmetry, cost boundary, cross-asset dispersion) that can never cull a cohort and can only move a PASS to DEFERRED; the stability reader reads its split-half deviation only off rows carrying >= 10 observations in EACH half (>= 3 such rows), otherwise it reports insufficient_evidence and does not trigger - a deviation read off nearly empty rows measures sparsity, not instability
